policy_amendment.interpretation: idempotency_required remains the unconditional requirement; the new condition requires the header whenever true. Add this optional condition to the policy schema before use; absence means no additional conditional requirement, never bypass a true condition

operation.actor_id: current authenticated user ID as exact decimal string
operation.times: created_at=started_at=finished_at=updated_at=final SQL UTC; deadline_at=minimum original admission deadline, strictly later
operation.success_means: confirmed atomic admission only; never provider read, bytes written or client receipt
operation.public_representation: complete Operation through existing authorized operation detail/list; GET download body remains evidence bytes
operation.redacted_response: exact bounded JCS bytes of the complete public Operation, independent from the private claim receipt; never claim that GET returned this JSON

signed_request.hash: lowercase SHA-256 over UTF-8 RFC 8785 JCS, no BOM or trailing newline
signed_request.manifest_hash: SHA-256 of the existing immutable evidence Manifest canonical bytes, including identity, key reference, envelope/object hashes, sizes, chunk root and complete ordered chunks; not a caller hash or content hash alone
signed_request.subject_session: exact authenticated RegistrationActor.Subject and RegistrationActor.Session, equal to ProofPayload subject/session; session is the existing digest, never bearer bytes
signed_request.range: existing parseRange against locked manifest ContentSize; zero-based inclusive safe integers; normalized open/suffix/closed ranges with equal offsets hash equally; absent versus explicit full range differ by range_present
signed_request.empty_content: range_start=range_end=0 only when Range is absent and ContentSize=0, matching the existing parser; Range on empty content rejects
signed_request.idempotency_key: exact single Idempotency-Key header, 16..128 ASCII; separately bound in signed ProofPayload and operation unique key, not a request-body field
signed_request.claim_binding: server random claim is excluded from pre-signing request; same-transaction immutable receipt binds claim digest and exact admitted evidence row version to nonce.operation_id
signed_request.invalid_transport: reject duplicate proof/key/Range headers, multiple ranges, malformed integers, unsafe offsets, invalid Unicode and unknown JSON proof fields before mutation

receipt.encoding: UTF-8 JCS; SHA-256 and byte length stored and verified independently; maximum 8192 bytes
receipt.claim_sha256: SHA-256 over exact ASCII server claim, used only for binding, never as a transferable capability
receipt.storage: new immutable installation-scoped receipt keyed by operation, with inline public Operation snapshot separately retained; no provider I/O inside admission transaction
receipt.joins: operation, target evidence, receipt and nonce installation must agree; receipt operation/target/audit identities and public Operation bytes must match independent SQL rows

transaction.owner: D SQL registry owns one RepeatableRead *sql.Tx and alone commits; A verifier borrows the exact tx and cannot begin/commit/retry it
transaction.database: validate server UUID, database and UTC before locking
lock_order: L0 all installation rows and missing ranges, ordered, shared with existing nonce/config writers
L1 current installation/config and immutable required historical nonce-key version snapshot
L2 user, live session, credential/revocation and current owner/RBAC authority
L3 exact actor/endpoint/key operation and receipt keys, including missing ranges
L4 owner/task facts needed by the existing evidence policy
L5 target references/holds and every historical nonce HMAC candidate in stable order
L6 physical metadata reservation id=1 with pre-pinned bounded report
L7 intent audit INSERT with actual insert ID
L8 exact evidence row/chunks plus preselected new receipt/response slots; claim CAS and persist operation/receipt/nonce only against prelocked keys
L10 final guards and fresh SQL UTC after callbacks and last write; commit with no external I/O
transaction.existing_callback_limitation: AuthorizeSensitiveDownload after evidence lock must receive a sealed prelocked prefix; it must not acquire L0-L7 afterward. Extend registry preparation before evidence lock, do not graft a standalone nonce transaction onto the current callback
transaction.audit_api: AuditIntent(ctx,*sql.Tx,Audit) (int64,error): one affected INSERT, actual sql.Result.LastInsertId, bounded by audit_logs INT PK, verify exact stored actor/action/evidence/claim-digest/range/time in that tx; no MAX/latest query or second intent INSERT
atomic_effects: immutable receipt and exact public Operation snapshot

nonce.operation_id: exact inserted admission operation primary key
nonce.key_versions: persisted config history union all retained ledger versions including active; reject empty, duplicate, unresolved, removed or changed version snapshot
nonce.cross_version_check: A computes all candidate HMACs; D checks every candidate with current locking reads before insert under active key. All consumers and key-history changes share L0 serialization; per-version UNIQUE alone is insufficient
nonce.no_row_on_failure: this download protocol rolls back on every rejection; do not persist an immutable-failure nonce as a stand-in for admission

final_guards: same config and complete HMAC history snapshot
same manifest/classification and exact claim/row-version CAS
fresh monotonic SQL UTC after last callback and last write
transaction.original_deadlines: never extend proof/session/claim/config/material deadlines during rechecks; require final SQL UTC strictly before their minimum
transaction.rollback: all atomic effects absent; original proof may be retried only while valid and after fresh current checks
transaction.commit_unknown: no provider Stat/read, plaintext, operation success header or automatic retry; later exact authorized receipt lookup is diagnostic only and cannot resume streaming

replay.same_key_same_hash: 409 idempotency_conflict, no resend or second nonce, after current authentication and scope checks
replay.expired_retained_idempotency_marker: 410 idempotency_expired, never recycle key while a retained marker exists
replay.new_attempt: fresh key and fresh proof/nonce; must pass current authorization and exact evidence claim/readiness; no automatic retries after partial send

error_precedence: establish live authentication/current target permission, classification, transport and non-consuming proof signature/issuer/binding/expiry validity first; then an authorized existing key yields idempotency_conflict or idempotency_expired before nonce replay lookup. Missing or expired proof never becomes a successful idempotency replay. All final guards still apply before any new admission

after_commit.checks: recheck current session/RBAC/owner/claim before provider access and again before first plaintext; retain existing bounded read and range checks
after_commit.result_audit: separate append linked to operation, claim digest and intent ID: read_failed, rejected, disconnected or local_write_completed; never mutate consumed nonce/admission or assert client receipt
after_commit.failure_after_headers: terminate stream and record result; cannot replace already emitted bytes with JSON error
after_commit.result_audit_failure: send failure to existing durable failure reporting path; never erase admission or permit replay

lifecycle.retain_until: freeze one group deadline no earlier than max(admitted_at + current control_metadata_retention_seconds, existing target protected_until, required idempotency/nonce/audit retention deadlines); later config cannot shorten it
lifecycle.references: RESTRICT same-installation links prevent deleting operation/audit anchors while nonce or receipt survives; target holds/reference lifecycle must prevent dangling admission references, not create immortal evidence
lifecycle.historical_keys: retain every referenced nonce-HMAC key until the last referring ledger row passes retention; missing old material fails closed
lifecycle.capacity: reserve and finally recheck actual shared physical metadata capacity for the entire atomic group before INSERT, including audit/nonce/receipt/index overhead; JSON payload length or INFORMATION_SCHEMA estimates alone are insufficient
lifecycle.grants_gc: runtime receipt writer has exact INSERT/SELECT and no receipt UPDATE/DELETE; reviewed GC alone removes eligible groups after holds/retention/reference checks, preserving conflict markers for their required lifetime

required_shared_amendments: admin-operation-policy schema/registry: conditional recent strong auth and conditional idempotency for confidential/sensitive GET
admin.openapi.json: optional wire Idempotency-Key required by classification, proof transport, Range, binary 200/206, success operation ID header and exact error profile
status-failure-enums, task-operation DTO and readers: evidence_download_admission/evidence with sev_ target; complete public Operation, independent private receipt
strong-auth nonce/proof schema: indirect claim binding, all-version transaction locks, admission result anchor and diagnostic-only retries

new append-only reviewed SQL migration: operation enums/CHECKs, immutable receipt/snapshot and same-installation FK/retention/capacity/grants; never edit published 066/075 or renumber 081/082 proposals
review_boundary: D confirms these interface and transaction decisions now. Shared OpenAPI/DTO/enums/evidence/schema amendments still need recorded A/B/C reviews under the existing registry; no approved_reviewers are fabricated. A can implement/test candidates against this exact decision before formal runtime activation.
